title: Pull a retractable dog leash out to 25 cm against recoil tension, press the brake and slide its lock home
instruction: Pull the dog leash out to the green 25 cm band, press and slide its thumb lock to lock the reel there, then let go.
context: Dog owners lock a retractable leash at a short length before crossing a road or passing a crowd. Unlike holding a pulled-out tape measure or clipping a belt barrier, the reel pulls back the whole time, and only a press-in-then-slide thumb lock, done while the other hand holds the housing, keeps the tape out once both hands let go.
setup: Positions in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left); fixed layout. Dark slate silicone mat, 22 x 54.5 x 0.4 cm, at x 16 to 38, y -21 to +33.5, taped down. Anchor post: galvanized steel pipe 3.34 cm OD in a 9.5 cm floor flange, 7 cm tall, at x 26.5, y +38.3, clamped to the table; a red 2.5 cm nylon dog collar is buckled round it with its chrome D-ring toward the mat. Retractable dog leash (TUG 360 Small, 16 ft of 9.5 mm orange nylon tape; ABS and rubber housing 17.3 x 10.9 x 3.3 cm, 330 g: white 9.6 cm reel drum, blue handle loop, orange 1.4 x 2.4 x 1.8 cm thumb button) lies flat on the mat, tape wound in, snap hook clipped to the D-ring, snout at x 26.5, y +33.0, handle toward the right arm (housing to y +15.7), button on the near edge at x 20.7, y +21.4. The button locks the reel when pressed 1.1 cm in (+x) and then slid 1.1 cm forward (+y). Recoil pull 2.5 N at 0 cm, 5.0 N at 25 cm. White metric ruler strip, 2.4 x 37 cm, along x 35 from 0 cm at y +33.0 (the snout) to 35 cm at y -2.0, with green tape over 23 to 27 cm (y +6 to +10).
scoring: At the end: ruler reading at the snout's front face, an end photo, and the trial video's final 3 s (in sim, every step of the final 3.0 s). Score 0 if during the final 3 s either gripper is open less than 70 mm, any finger pad is within 30 mm of the leash housing or button, the lock is not engaged (brake pressed at least 5 mm and button slid at least 8.5 mm forward; real: orange button forward in its lock position), or the snout moves 2.0 mm or more along the ruler. Otherwise, by the snout's final position: 1.00 for 23.0 to 27.0 cm (green band); 0.50 for 20.0 to 30.0 cm; 0.20 for 10.0 cm or more outside that; 0.00 under 10.0 cm. Pressing without sliding lets the tape reel in on release (0); holding the housing to the end scores 0. Possible scores: 0, 0.2, 0.5, 1.0.
reset_notes: Pull the orange button back so it pops up, let the tape reel in gently by hand, and lay the housing flat with its snout at the 0 cm mark. Nothing is consumed.
fidelity: The housing slides on a level sprung joint along the tape line (10 N/m, 2.5 to 5 N, estimated), not free on the mat with a clock-spring reel, so it cannot yaw or lift. Reel brake modelled: pressed 5.5 mm or more, the reel stops (60 N slide friction). Catch lip and lug are real geometry; button return is a detent spring. Tape is look-only pieces. The sim scores without opening the grippers, so a held leash or a gripper under 70 mm open scores 0.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (reached over the ruler with the right arm, leash stayed near the post); demo: 1.0 (pulled the leash to the green band, pressed and slid the lock, backed away)
